smt2:
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-fun a1 () Bool)
(declare-fun a2 () Bool)
(declare-fun a3 () Bool)
(declare-fun x () Int)
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) a1 a2 a3))
(assert (=> a1 (= x 1)))
(assert (=> a2 (= x 2)))
(assert (=> a3 (= x 3)))
(check-sat-assuming ((= x 3)))
; Result: sat

(set-logic ALL)
(declare-fun x () Int)
(assert (or (= x 1) (= x 2) (= x 3)))
(check-sat-assuming ((= x 3)))
; Result: sat
